links.outcome: Accuracy, detail, and risk of harm of GPT chatbots versus licensed pharmacists on same inquiries
links.effect: GPT-4 had 64.3% completely accurate responses, comparable to human pharmacists; both delivered 95% safe responses; GPT-4 gave proactive risk mitigation info in 70% vs 25.7% for pharmacists.
links.quote: GPT-4 had 64.3% completely accurate responses, comparable to human pharmacists.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-3, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4 accuracy, detail, and safety on retrospective real-world drug-related inquiries compared to licensed pharmacists, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
